stories.title: Dolly Parton, one of country music's most singular performers, has died at age 80
stories.summary: The artist was a star performer in country music and went on to become one of the genre's most recognizable and universally adored ambassadors to broader popular culture.

stories.title: Sen. Darline Graham wins GOP nomination for U.S. Senate in South Carolina
stories.summary: In a major win for President Trump who went all in for the political newcomer, Sen. Darline Graham beat out longtime Congressman Ralph Norman in a special election primary runoff in South Carolina.

stories.title: What the Supreme Court's ruling on mail-in voting means for Nevada's voters
stories.summary: The Supreme Court on Monday handed President Trump an interim win in his effort to limit mail-in voting.

stories.title: Tulsa bakes in high temperatures and high electric bills
stories.summary: The cost of electricity has been rising faster than inflation. Tulsa, Okla., has been baking in triple-digit temperatures. And some residents are in danger of having their power cut off.

stories.title: High-intensity sprints can trigger molecular changes in the bloodstream
stories.summary: Scientists are increasingly interested in how different exercise intensities can trigger different responses in the body. A new study finds that an all out sprint may have unique benefits.

stories.title: Mexican cattle allowed in the U.S. after a yearlong ban
stories.summary: A border crossing in Arizona opened to cattle from Mexico for the first time in more than a year. This despite a parasite being found on the Mexican side. U.S. ranchers are upset.
